verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה־ עֹ֑רֶף פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš tō·w·ḵā·ḥō·wṯ maq·šeh- ‘ō·rep̄ pe·ṯa‘ yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·’ên mar·pê
verses.literal: A man who remains stiff-necked . . . after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery
verses.literalPt: O HOMEM que muitas vezes repreendido endurece a cerviz, de repente será destruído sem que haja remédio.

verses.original: בִּרְב֣וֹת צַ֭דִּיקִים יִשְׂמַ֣ח הָעָ֑ם וּבִמְשֹׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע יֵאָ֥נַֽח עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bir·ḇō·wṯ ṣad·dî·qîm yiś·maḥ hā·‘ām ū·ḇim·šōl rā·šā‘ yê·’ā·naḥ ‘ām
verses.literal: When the righteous flourish the people rejoice but when the wicked rule the people groan
verses.literalPt: Quando os justos se engrandecem, o povo se alegra, mas quando o ímpio domina, o povo geme.

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־ אֹהֵ֣ב חָ֭כְמָה יְשַׂמַּ֣ח אָבִ֑יו וְרֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד־ הֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš- ’ō·hêḇ ḥāḵ·māh yə·śam·maḥ ’ā·ḇîw wə·rō·‘eh zō·w·nō·wṯ yə·’ab·beḏ- hō·wn
verses.literal: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth
verses.literalPt: O homem que ama a sabedoria alegra a seu pai, mas o companheiro de prostitutas desperdiça os bens.

verses.original: מֶ֗לֶךְ בְּ֭מִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִ֣יד אָ֑רֶץ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּרוּמ֣וֹת יֶֽהֶרְסֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ bə·miš·pāṭ ya·‘ă·mîḏ ’ā·reṣ wə·’îš tə·rū·mō·wṯ ye·her·sen·nāh
verses.literal: By justice a king brings stability to the land but a man who exacts tribute demolishes it
verses.literalPt: O rei com juízo sustém a terra, mas o amigo de peitas a transtorna.

verses.original: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק עַל־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל־ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ge·ḇer ma·ḥă·lîq ‘al- rê·‘ê·hū re·šeṯ pō·w·rêś ‘al- pə·‘ā·māw
verses.literal: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads . . . a net for his feet
verses.literalPt: O homem que lisonjeia o seu próximo arma uma rede aos seus passos.

verses.original: בְּפֶ֤שַֽׁע אִ֣ישׁ רָ֣ע מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄e·ša‘ ’îš rā‘ mō·w·qêš wə·ṣad·dîq yā·rūn wə·śā·mê·aḥ
verses.literal: An evil man is caught by his own sin but a righteous one sings and rejoices
verses.literalPt: Na transgressão do homem mau há laço, mas o justo jubila e se alegra.

verses.original: יֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא־ יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: yō·ḏê·a‘ ṣad·dîq dîn dal·lîm rā·šā‘ lō- yā·ḇîn dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: The righteous consider the cause of the poor but the wicked have no regard for such concerns
verses.literalPt: O justo se informa da causa dos pobres, mas o ímpio nem sequer toma conhecimento.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָ֭צוֹן יָפִ֣יחוּ קִרְיָ֑ה וַ֝חֲכָמִ֗ים יָשִׁ֥יבוּ אָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê lā·ṣō·wn yā·p̄î·ḥū qir·yāh wa·ḥă·ḵā·mîm yā·šî·ḇū ’āp̄
verses.literal: Mockers . . . inflame a city but the wise turn away anger
verses.literalPt: Os homens escarnecedores alvoroçam a cidade, mas os sábios desviam a ira.

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־ חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת־ אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְרָגַ֥ז וְ֝שָׂחַ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין נָֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš- ḥā·ḵām niš·pāṭ ’eṯ- ’îš ’ĕ·wîl wə·rā·ḡaz wə·śā·ḥaq wə·’ên nā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: If a wise man goes to court with . . . a fool there will be raving and laughing with no resolution
verses.literalPt: O homem sábio que pleiteia com o tolo, quer se zangue, quer se ria, não terá descanso.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־ תָ֑ם וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê ḏā·mîm yiś·nə·’ū- ṯām wî·šā·rîm yə·ḇaq·šū nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man but the upright care for his life
verses.literalPt: Os homens sanguinários odeiam ao sincero, mas os justos procuram o seu bem.

verses.original: כָּל־ ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- rū·ḥōw yō·w·ṣî ḵə·sîl wə·ḥā·ḵām bə·’ā·ḥō·wr yə·šab·bə·ḥen·nāh
verses.literal: A fool vents all his anger but a wise man holds it back
verses.literalPt: O tolo revela todo o seu pensamento, mas o sábio o guarda até o fim.

verses.original: מֹ֭שֵׁל מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־ דְּבַר־ שָׁ֑קֶר כָּֽל־ מְשָׁרְתָ֥יו רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šêl maq·šîḇ ‘al- də·ḇar- šā·qer kāl- mə·šā·rə·ṯāw rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: If a ruler listens to lies . . . all his officials will be wicked
verses.literalPt: O governador que dá atenção às palavras mentirosas, achará que todos os seus servos são ímpios.

verses.original: רָ֤שׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּכָכִ֣ים נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ מֵ֤אִיר־ עֵינֵ֖י שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rāš wə·’îš tə·ḵā·ḵîm nip̄·gā·šū mê·’îr- ‘ê·nê šə·nê·hem Yah·weh
verses.literal: The poor man and the oppressor . . . have this in common The LORD gives light to the eyes of both
verses.literalPt: O pobre e o usurário se encontram; o SENHOR ilumina os olhos de ambos.

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֣ט בֶּֽאֱמֶ֣ת דַּלִּ֑ים כִּ֝סְא֗וֹ לָעַ֥ד יִכּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ šō·w·p̄êṭ be·’ĕ·meṯ dal·lîm kis·’ōw lā·‘aḏ yik·kō·wn
verses.literal: A king who judges the poor with fairness his throne will be established forever
verses.literalPt: O rei que julga os pobres conforme a verdade firmará o seu trono para sempre.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣בֶט וְ֭תוֹכַחַת יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה וְנַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šê·ḇeṭ wə·ṯō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ yit·tên ḥāḵ·māh wə·na·‘ar mə·šul·lāḥ mê·ḇîš ’im·mōw
verses.literal: A rod of correction imparts wisdom but a child left to himself disgraces his mother
verses.literalPt: A vara e a repreensão dão sabedoria, mas a criança entregue a si mesma, envergonha a sua mãe.

verses.original: בִּרְב֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה־ פָּ֑שַׁע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽמַפַּלְתָּ֥ם יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bir·ḇō·wṯ rə·šā·‘îm yir·beh- pā·ša‘ wə·ṣad·dî·qîm bə·map·pal·tām yir·’ū
verses.literal: When the wicked thrive rebellion increases but the righteous will see their downfall
verses.literalPt: Quando os ímpios se multiplicam, multiplicam-se as transgressões, mas os justos verão a sua queda.

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ וִֽינִיחֶ֑ךָ וְיִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yas·sêr bin·ḵā wî·nî·ḥe·ḵā wə·yit·tên ma·‘ă·ḏan·nîm lə·nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Discipline your son and he will give you rest he will bring delight to your soul
verses.literalPt: Castiga o teu filho, e te dará descanso; e dará delícias à tua alma.

verses.original: בְּאֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן יִפָּ֣רַֽע עָ֑ם וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה אַשְׁרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ên ḥā·zō·wn yip·pā·ra‘ ‘ām wə·šō·mêr tō·w·rāh ’aš·rê·hū
verses.literal: Where there is no vision the people cast off restraint but blessed is he who keeps the Law
verses.literalPt: Não havendo profecia, o povo perece; porém o que guarda a lei, esse é bem-aventurado.

verses.original: בִּ֭דְבָרִים לֹא־ יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי־ יָ֝בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biḏ·ḇā·rîm lō- yiw·wā·ser ‘ā·ḇeḏ kî- yā·ḇîn wə·’ên ma·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: A servant cannot be corrected by words alone though he understands he will not respond
verses.literalPt: O servo não se emendará com palavras, porque, ainda que entenda, todavia não atenderá.

verses.original: חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ אָ֣ץ בִּדְבָרָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zî·ṯā ’îš ’āṣ biḏ·ḇā·rāw tiq·wāh liḵ·sîl mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Do you see a man who speaks in haste There is more hope for a fool than for him
verses.literalPt: Tens visto um homem precipitado no falar? Maior esperança há para um tolo do que para ele.

verses.original: מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִנֹּ֣עַר עַבְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝אַחֲרִית֗וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: mə·p̄an·nêq min·nō·‘ar ‘aḇ·dōw wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw yih·yeh mā·nō·wn
verses.literal: A servant pampered from his youth will bring grief in the end
verses.literalPt: Quando alguém cria o seu servo com mimos desde a meninice, por fim ele tornar-se-á seu filho.

verses.original: אִֽישׁ־ אַ֭ף יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבַ֖עַל חֵמָ֣ה רַב־ פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš- ’ap̄ yə·ḡā·reh mā·ḏō·wn ū·ḇa·‘al ḥê·māh raḇ- pā·ša‘
verses.literal: An angry man stirs up dissension and a hot-tempered man abounds in transgression
verses.literalPt: O homem irascível levanta contendas; e o furioso multiplica as transgressões.

verses.original: גַּאֲוַ֣ת אָ֭דָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶ֑נּוּ וּשְׁפַל־ ר֝֗וּחַ יִתְמֹ֥ךְ כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: ga·’ă·waṯ ’ā·ḏām taš·pî·len·nū ū·šə·p̄al- rū·aḥ yiṯ·mōḵ kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: A man’s pride will bring him low but a humble spirit will obtain honor
verses.literalPt: A soberba do homem o abaterá, mas a honra sustentará o humilde de espírito.

verses.original: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם־ גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אָלָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·w·lêq ‘im- gan·nāḇ śō·w·nê nap̄·šōw ’ā·lāh yiš·ma‘ wə·lō yag·gîḏ
verses.literal: A partner to a thief hates his own soul he receives the oath but does not testify
verses.literalPt: O que tem parte com o ladrão odeia a sua própria alma; ouve maldições, e não o denuncia.

verses.original: חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ḥer·daṯ ’ā·ḏām yit·tên mō·w·qêš ū·ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ Yah·weh yə·śug·gāḇ
verses.literal: The fear of man is a snare but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high
verses.literalPt: O temor do homem armará laços, mas o que confia no SENHOR será posto em alto retiro.

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים פְּנֵי־ מוֹשֵׁ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּט־ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm mə·ḇaq·šîm pə·nê- mō·wō·šêl Yah·weh miš·paṭ- ’îš
verses.literal: Many seek the ruler’s favor but a man receives justice from the LORD
verses.literalPt: Muitos buscam o favor do poderoso, mas o juízo de cada um vem do SENHOR.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים אִ֣ישׁ עָ֑וֶל וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע יְשַׁר־ דָּֽרֶךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ ṣad·dî·qîm ’îš ‘ā·wel wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ rā·šā‘ yə·šar- dā·reḵ
verses.literal: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked
verses.literalPt: Abominação é, para os justos, o homem iníquo; mas abominação é para o iníquo o de retos caminhos.
